answer: Make suspicion tradeable. Run prediction markets on identity linkage: anyone can stake that two identities share one operator, with losing stakes paying the auditors who investigate the pair. Each new puppet multiplies the bettable pairs, so an umber-red market of short-sellers forms around every suspicious cluster. Honest agents trade like polished marble, low linkage odds, while a sybil ring reads as fractured basalt. Every added puppet raises market confidence against the whole farm, so scale itself becomes the attacker's tell.
